payload.purpose_context: Seven small defects reported against 4.0.0rc9 each make a status, planning or glossary command fail, refuse valid input, or silently lose information: the status event log reader splits rows on characters that are not line breaks and lets JSON-limit errors escape its documented error type; the log writer can emit non-standard NaN/Infinity numbers and Windows line endings; the event sanitiser crashes on a mixed naive/aware session pair; the two work package task-file locators disagree on letter case; map-shaped subtask entries are silently coerced so the for_review gate can never pass; a mission meta.json with a UTF-8 byte-order mark makes the Mission invisible; and glossary conflict listing slows quadratically. This mission fixes each with the smallest change that converges core on the rulings spec-kitty-events already records, and repairs the one in-repo Mission (058) whose data the stricter subtask rule would otherwise refuse.
payload.purpose_tldr: Fix seven small, independently reported defects in the status event log, work package task-file reading, mission metadata loading and glossary conflict listing.
